name: @kitn.ai/ui-app-composed-thread
description: Rung 6 of the iteration ladder: a chat client whose conversation UI is composed by hand from standalone kai-* elements — no <kai-chat> anywhere. kai-thread + kai-composer + kai-attachments wired by a host module; mock responder with a scripted tool call; file attach round-trip. Plain Vite + TypeScript, no framework.
